title: a boolean choice with an untagged [] or [:] on one side: literal and variable conditions, typed uses
purpose: Observe that a compact choice keeps the analyzed collection type when its condition is a literal (#298).

stdout.text:
true true true true
true true
0 0 1
true 7
true

provenance.origin: authored for #298 from the Book (24.3) and the spec
provenance.expected_basis: Book 24.3: the left side is bool, the branch types agree, only the selected branch is evaluated (the other panics); an empty literal takes the collection type of the other branch, so every comparison with [] or [:] holds and sizes are 0, 0 and 1.
